article.title: Review a developer-cache cleanup list before removing it
article.primaryIntent: Distinguish rebuildable caches from project inputs in a mixed developer cleanup list; Space Hunter supplies the concrete category context, not an invented hands-on result.
article.description: Space Hunter documents package caches, Docker images and Python environments in its cleanup coverage. Review ownership, recovery cost and exact proposed paths before treating those categories as disposable.
sections: Start with the actual category, owner and exact path, not an advertised GB total
Separate downloadable caches from project environments and retained images
Ask what must be rebuilt or downloaded and what is backed up
Review deletion method and approvals; where documentation stops, label unknown
Choose category cleanup or longer-running investigation with preview caveats
article.evidenceBoundary: No cleanup steps tested. Before publishing generic Docker/virtual-environment recovery advice, source applicable official tool documentation; do not translate vendor safety slogans into guarantees.
article.interactionPass: A non-executing checklist: path/owner known? original or generated? recovery source available? rebuild cost acceptable? method/approval clear? Unknown returns investigate, never delete. No filesystem access, estimated savings or cleanup button.
article.visualPlacement: Official Space Hunter UI immediately after lead only after rights clearance; labeled Breathing Room Space preview later when discussing investigation. Link-only fallback does not satisfy image gate.
article.distinctness: Workflow is pre-cleanup classification and recovery planning; comparison below is a compact purchase/fit decision. Do not produce a third alternatives doorway.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs Space Hunter
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose a Mac storage workflow by documented coverage, platform, licence and investigation needs.
comparison.lead: Space Hunter documents category cleanup with a one-time, single-device Pro licence. Breathing Room, which we build, combines source-implemented storage and activity investigation in an explicitly limited preview with optional hosted AI Care.
rows: free cleaning quota versus free local capabilities
one-time major-version licence versus optional renewing AI Care
review controls and unverified execution details
live free-space tracking versus source-implemented activity history
comparison.decision: Prefer Space Hunter when its named categories and one-device major-version offer match the job, after checking paths and requirements. Consider Breathing Room for grouped app/activity investigation only with preview, Python, hosted-service and testing limitations understood.
